title.en: An Act Authorizing Municipal Councils to Provide for the Insurance of the Life of Barrio Lieutenants Against Accidents and Other Causes, Amending for the Purpose Section Twenty-Two Hundred and Forty-Three of the Administrative Code as Amended

text.en:
Section twenty-two hundred and forty-three Administrative Code, as amended, is further ended by adding at the end thereof the following subparagraph:
"(u) To provide for the insurance of the life of all barrio lieutenants in the municipality against accidents, murders and assaults for a sum not exceeding one thousand pesos each."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 16, 1950.
